description: Quantification of Seismic Column Rotation in Steel Special Moment Frames via Nonlinear Dynamic Analysis is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Shitao Shi, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (illinois.edu). This project focuses on investigating the rotational behavior of columns in Steel Special Moment Frames (SMFs) under seismic loading conditions. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: Earthquake Engineering, Seismic Local Buckling Limits, Column Rotation, Steel Structures. Published 2024-12-09. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
